## Overview

MarkdStage v2.5.1 preserves CSS padding and borders when exporting editable PowerPoint text boxes.
Single-line text, including deck footers and page numbers, now stays on one line when browser and
PowerPoint font metrics differ.

Release automation also verifies the exact versioned CLI tarball name, and continuous integration
uses changed-path detection to run the relevant checks more efficiently.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks, Canvas Extension
installations, CLI commands, and Desktop workflows.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v2.5.1`. |
| Offline CLI installation | Download and install `markdstage-markdstage-2.5.1.tgz` from the GitHub Release. |
| PowerPoint export | No migration is required; newly exported editable text preserves its spacing automatically. |
